coordinateOrigin: top-left; rectangles are [x, y, width, height] in original source pixels, not screen points

frames.visualReview: Original and generated full-size images individually inspected. Both eyelids are fully closed with delicate lashes. Head tilt, face position, youthful identity and small mouth appear stable. Fine room detail regenerated outside eyes; never swap the full candidate into the stage.

differenceInspection.method: Read-only mean absolute per-channel RGB difference between original files; no raster edit or assertion runner.
differenceInspection.meaning: Supports change localization only; does not certify pixel alignment, mask seams or blink quality.

frames.visualReview: Original and generated full-size images individually inspected. Both eyelids naturally closed, original neutral small mouth retained; pose and visible support stay recognizable. Background and fine texture are re-rendered, so the full frame is not a safe animation replacement.

differenceInspection.method: Read-only mean absolute per-channel RGB difference between original files; no raster edit or assertion runner.
differenceInspection.meaning: Supports change localization only; does not certify pixel alignment, mask seams or blink quality.

nativeIntegrationProposal.base: Keep the approved mother/background/contact composition permanently in place. Candidate is a separate overlay masked to the two small eye regions only; do not include the mouth, nose, head outline or hair silhouette.
nativeIntegrationProposal.geometry: Use the original 1536x1024 canvas and the exact existing stage crop/scale for the overlay. Do not independently resize, translate, stretch or warp the eyes or face. Convert y to height-y-heightOfRect only when an API uses a bottom-left image origin.
nativeIntegrationProposal.mask: Begin with the two listed rectangles as conservative inspection bounds. Feather each outer boundary by about 2 source pixels and keep the entire original iris and generated closed lash inside the opaque interior. Adjust only after viewing the native composite at normal size and enlarged.
nativeIntegrationProposal.timingStatus: Proposal for actual native viewing, not a measured or approved motion specification. Avoid long crossfades that leave both an iris and closed lash visible.
nativeIntegrationProposal.lifecycle: Do not begin random blinking until the closed image is ready. Reset to the unchanged open source when hidden/inactive, in low power or reduce motion, or while transitioning day/night. Never let a late day result overlay the night face.
nativeIntegrationProposal.acceptanceStillRequired: Observe several complete blinks in both daylight and night at normal speed; inspect closed-state iris coverage, seams, skin tone, eyelid placement and absence of mouth/head/body motion. Review reduction/stop/resume and rapid daylight changes. Static source inspection cannot establish these outcomes.

imageGeneration.postprocessing: none; all generated candidates copied byte-for-byte
